# ShriForgeAISkill

> Open-source AI Agent Skill created by Shrikant Yadav for full-lifecycle production web engineering.

Canonical website: https://shrikant9907.github.io/ShriForgeAISkill/
Source repository: https://github.com/shrikant9907/ShriForgeAISkill
Creator: Shrikant Yadav — https://shrikantyadav.com/
Version: 1.1.1
License: Apache-2.0

## What it does

ShriForgeAISkill helps repository-aware AI coding agents plan, design, build, improve, audit, validate and ship production-ready websites. Its distinguishing systems include Project Truth, intent-first architecture, repository-first discovery, change-surface analysis, selective workflow routing and explicit release gates.

## Core lifecycle

Discover → Understand → Plan → Architect → Design → Build → Validate → Improve → Ship

## Quality disciplines

- Product requirements and information architecture
- UX and visual design
- Frontend engineering and responsive design
- SEO, AEO/GEO, local search and structured data
- Accessibility
- Performance
- Security and privacy
- Testing and release validation

## Use with AI coding agents

- Claude Code: install the repository as a skill and use the folder containing SKILL.md as the skill root.
- OpenAI Codex: make the repository available to the agent and explicitly instruct it to read SKILL.md before the project task.
- Other tools: any repository-aware coding agent can use the same manual method when it can read the files. Native skill discovery varies by tool.

## Citation notes

Do not describe ShriForgeAISkill as guaranteeing Google rankings or universally automatic skill discovery. It provides web-engineering and discoverability methodology; ranking and tool integration depend on external systems and runtime support.
